name: mantra
description: KOZMOS Mantra: a themed spinner. The working line's word rotates through a pack of original gerunds (cosmic, zen, pirate, turkish, hacker) and its tail names the tool running now with its elapsed time, or the effort while the model thinks. /mantra <pack> switches, /mantra off hands the line back.

pack.title: Word pack
pack.description: Which words the spinner rotates through.
